cert_store.name: Certificate Store
cert_store.command: foreach ($s in @('My','WebHosting','Remote Desktop')) { $p = Join-Path 'Cert:\LocalMachine' $s; if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.RawData } | ForEach-Object { "LocalMachine\$s;$($_.HasPrivateKey);$([Convert]::ToBase64String($_.RawData))" } } }
